title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Overview

We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer at Canonical . Location: Globally remote role.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives across public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world\'s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. Canonical is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role

We deploy and run OpenStack, Kubernetes, storage solutions, and open source applications, applying DevOps practices. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure DevOps practices, raising the bar on what\'s possible with automation by embracing a model-driven approach, whether on-premise or on public clouds. We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes clusters, and applications for customers across both physical and public cloud estates. We identify and address incidents, monitor and observe applications, anticipate potential issues, and enable product refinement to achieve high-quality standards in our open source portfolio. To succeed in this role, you need a strong background in Linux, Python, networking, and knowledge of how clouds work. Your work will encompass the entire stack, from bare-metal networking and kernel up to Kubernetes and open source applications. You can expect to be trained in our core technologies like OpenStack, Kubernetes, security standards, open source products like Kubeflow, Kafka, OpenSearch, databases, and many others. Automation for us is a software engineering problem that we approach with a scientific mindset to bring operations at scale, driven by metrics and code.

Location: Globally remote role

To become a member of our team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from bare metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in operations with mission-critical services for global brand-name customers. As a member of the team, you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure.

What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in software engineering or computer science
  • Python software development experience
  • Operational experience in Linux environments
  • Experience with Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Bonus skills

  • Familiarity with OpenStack deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public cloud deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with private cloud management

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We adjust compensation every 6 months to recognize outstanding performance, and in addition to base pay, we offer annual bonuses. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Every 6 months compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet your colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We publish Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects, and support AI, IoT, and cloud initiatives. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Security Engineer
description:
4 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security:

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
Overview


GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)


Location: 100% Remote


Type: Full-Time / Contract


About the Role


We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.



Responsibilities



  • Develop QA/QC Scripts: Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as: Missing or invalid geometry; Polygon overlaps or gaps; Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly).

  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager: Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling automatic validation after data edits or updates; flagging and reporting of errors for correction; consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards.

  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.

  • Collaborate: Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.



Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.

  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .

  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .

  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .

  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .

  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.



Preferred Qualifications



  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.

  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.

  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.



What You’ll Achieve


You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

  • Mid-Senior level

title: Senior Resource Management Analyst
description:
For over 15 years, ArcTouch has created lovable apps, websites, and connected experiences for world-class companies, leading brands, and innovative startups. See some of our work .

Since launching our first app in 2009, we’ve followed these core beliefs:

  • Create lovable products, the perfect blend of something useful and delightful that forges meaningful connections with users.
  • Be a lovable company where amazing teams of diverse individuals collaborate every day to create something we can be proud of.

If you're passionate about building lovable products, we want you to join us!

Know the Resource Management Role

This is not a traditional scheduling role; it is a high-impact, strategic position that sits at the critical nexus of our company's operations and human capital strategies. Resource Management is the central point of convergence where our financial objectives, operational capacity, and talent strategy are reconciled and optimized. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of resource allocation, from strategic forecasting to daily operational management, driving efficiency and on-time delivery across our entire project portfolio, ensuring the right people with the right skills are on the right projects at the right time.

  • Proactively forecast future staffing and skill requirements by analyzing the sales pipeline, committed projects, and strategic business initiatives.
  • Conduct comprehensive audits of our current workforce to document skill sets and identify areas of under- or over-utilization.
  • Advise senior leadership on key strategic decisions, including the trade-offs between hiring full-time employees versus engaging contractors to fill a skills gap.
  • Identify future skills gaps by comparing forecasted demand with current capacity, informing our strategic hiring, training, and contractor engagement decisions.
  • Model "what-if" scenarios, assessing the resource impact of major business events like a new contract win or changes in personnel.
  • Serve as the central point of contact for all resource requests, matching staff to projects based on skills, availability, project priority, and budget, optimizing staffing across the entire portfolio.
  • Act as a neutral broker to identify, mediate, and resolve resource conflicts that arise when multiple projects compete for the same talent.
  • Maintain our Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform as the "single source of truth" for all resource data.
  • Track, analyze, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as billable utilization, bench time, and forecast accuracy.
  • Build and maintain trusted and strong relationships with Account Managers, Product Managers, Functional Leaders, People Operations, and Finance, and facilitate a collaborative approach to staffing and planning.
  • Lead regular staffing meetings with senior leadership to present data, discuss challenges, and facilitate strategic decisions.
  • Ensure all stakeholders are kept informed of scheduling updates, allocation changes, and potential resource risks through clear and proactive communication.
  • Own and improve the ArcTouch Resource Management Process with a focus on efficiency and effectiveness, leveraging your process and agile skills background.
  • Own the relationship with our staffing partners and be responsible for onboarding and termination of all freelancers & contractors.
  • The Resource Management Analyst is not a management position. Therefore, there will be no direct reports.

Overview

Are you a hardworking Engineering Manager. API Technologies looking for an excellent opportunity? This could be a tremendous role to explore!

Aon is in the business of better decisions.

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

At Aon, as the Engineering Manager, of an Application Programming Interface (API) group, you will lead a team of engineers and vendors to deliver scalable, high-quality API solutions. Your role combines technical leadership with strategic alignment, staying hands-on through design reviews and code exemplars while coordinating closely with Product and Architecture to define the API roadmap and standards.

The person in this role will be responsible for the API catalog and developer portal, ensuring documentation and SDKs remain current, and work with Service Managers to align API capabilities with business needs. Leading all aspects of the entire API lifecycle, the individual in this role will handle versioning, compatibility, deprecation, and migration to ensure smooth transitions for all users.

You will maintain robust CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, drive comprehensive testing, and provide self-serve environments for partners. Platform operations will be driven by a strong emphasis on observability, security, and incident response, applying tools like DataDog and New Relic.

Vendor management will be a part of the remit, ensuring delivery to standards and effective knowledge transfer. Throughout, you will champion continuous improvement and strong cross-team collaboration, ensuring the API platform consistently delivers business value!

Responsibilities

  • Deliver new versions of core APIs, setting clear SLAs and SLOs while providing a structured deprecation path for legacy endpoints.
  • Create and maintain golden paths for API development, including OpenAPI-first workflows, contracts, and reusable CI/CD templates.
  • Standardize error handling and HTTP status codes, ensuring consistent use of correlation IDs and trace propagation for observability.
  • Integrate non-functional requirements into delivery, performance metrics such as latency, availability, and throughput. Track adoption through usage key performance indicators.
  • Lead capacity planning and load testing, applying resilience patterns like retries, idempotency, and circuit breakers, and conducting regular chaos testing.
  • Responsible for client onboarding processes, leading API credentials, key rotation, rate limits, and quotas to ensure secure and efficient access.
  • Coordinate change calendars and lead cross-team dependencies to keep multiple concurrent workstreams aligned.
  • Ensure services remain audit-ready by maintaining strict access controls, change logs, data retention policies, and compliance evidence within delivery pipelines.
  • Optimize infrastructure and resource costs by right-sizing compute, caching, and data storage while maintaining service levels.
  • Champion team growth through regular one-on-one meetings, actionable feedback, collaborative sessions, and clear performance expectations.

Skills and Experience That Will Lead to Success

  • At least 7 years of software engineering experience, including 2+ leading API teams or delivery as a technical lead or engineering manager
  • Deep expertise in .NET Core, with a strong understanding of modern API design and implementation
  • Advanced experience with Azure services, including API Management, AKS (Kubernetes), Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
  • Proficiency in OpenAPI/Swagger, schema governance, semantic versioning, and backward-compatibility strategies
  • Bake NFRs into DoD: p95/p99 latency, availability, throughput, startup time; track adoption and usage KPIs.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (YAML), using trunk-based development, feature flags, and code ownership practices
  • Demonstrated ability to implement and manage robust testing strategies, including contract testing (such as Pact), performance testing (k6 or JMeter), mocks, stubs, and automated pipeline gates
  • Strong background in observability, including distributed tracing, RED/USE metrics, SLOs, error budgets, and burn-rate alerting
  • Proven experience delivering secure APIs, with practical knowledge of OAuth2, mTLS, threat modeling, and secrets management
  • Solid understanding of data fundamentals, including SQL modeling, indexing, idempotency, and event-driven patterns
  • Practical experience managing vendor relationships, setting measurable SLAs, and ensuring knowledge transfer through gated deliveries
  • Effective cross-team collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to align technical work with business objectives
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent professional experience

Preferred

  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform), policy as code, and cloud cost optimization
  • Experience supporting partner or externally facing APIs, including developer portal management, quota enforcement, and monetization strategies
  • Understanding of compliance frameworks such as PCI or SOX, with experience maintaining audit-ready SDLC processes

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is diverse and values integrity, ownership, progress, and empathy. Ledn is remote-friendly and globally distributed.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams. Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services. Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD. Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features. Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications. Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens). Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows. Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads. Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs. Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments. Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management. Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring). Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks. Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals. Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and be comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company through shared equity.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides purpose and removes barriers so you love what you do.
  • Inclusive, equal opportunity employer; Ledn values diversity and inclusion.

Additional Information

description:
Overview

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours. We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.

We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team focuses on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products and deliver intuitive experiences for our customers while enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.
  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.
  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.
  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.
  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.
  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.
  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.
  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.
  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.
  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.
  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.
  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.
  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.
  • Proficient in UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.
  • Expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on comprehensive typing across the stack.
  • Experience breaking down product documents into feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.
  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and working with Figma and internal design systems.
  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.
  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability to advance organizational goals.

Our Values

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired GapFish (the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region) and in January 2022 completed the acquisition of Lucid, a programmatic research technology platform with access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

We are seeking a full‑time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long‑term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing‑resistant approaches. You will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures; hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals and remediation of vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.

  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information.

  • Remote‑friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can do your best work.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn is global with a remote‑first environment across North America, Latin America, South Africa, and Europe.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Security Engineer role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are a remote-first company with a global team and a culture of inclusion and collaboration.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

The Role

  • Application Security : Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity : Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves) : Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains : Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.
  • Nice To Haves : Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit : We are looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

  • The Ideal Candidate Will
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company through shared equity; Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We remove barriers so you love what you do.

EEO/Accommodations

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with people across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote-first environment.

Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

Our team is diverse and committed to democratizing access to the global economy through our products and services.

About The Role

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing applications and authentication systems. You will work across JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and evolve our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will also design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

What You Will Do

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews, define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services, automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD, conduct threat modeling and risk assessments, and partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication across customer and internal applications, enhance Cognito-based identity with stronger MFA solutions (WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens), align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows, and define secure session management and device trust approaches.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads, integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs, migrate high-value operations into enclave environments, and ensure compliance, auditability and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management, improve Kubernetes security posture, deploy and operate a SIEM framework with detection rules and incident playbooks, and support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

What You Bring To Ledn

  • Minimum 10 years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Experience with user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress, adaptability and resilience in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, ready to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability when managing confidential information across diverse contexts.
  • Have experience working in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities as LEDN is a leading digital asset company.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package that starts on day one, including competitive PTO and equity ownership.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career with barriers removed so you can do your best work.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. We provide accommodations throughout all stages of the recruitment process upon request and will address requests confidentially. Ledn is a remote-first, global team with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Security Engineer role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

What You Will Do

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams; define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services; automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD; conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features; partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications; enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens); collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows; define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads; integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management; improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring); deploy and operate a SIEM framework with detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks; support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals; remediating vulnerabilities identified in penetration test reports.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • Lead with adaptability and resilience, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale security practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Integrity and accountability in handling confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities at a leading digital asset company.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work flexibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career; we remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer; we value inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout all recruitment stages, contact Ledn confidentially at the provided email.

Working Environment

Ledn is truly global with a remote-first environment spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

Please note: due to high application volumes, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are changing the world for the better through building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full‑time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long‑term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing‑resistant approaches. You will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures; hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals and remediation of vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • Remote‑friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can do your best work.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Ledn is global with a remote‑first environment across North America, Latin America, South Africa, and Europe.

Please note, due to high application volume, only applicants who qualify will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response, and we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, unsolicited resumes will not be accepted.

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

  1. Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams. Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services. Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD. Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features. Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  2. Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications. Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens). Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows. Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  3. Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads. Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs. Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments. Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  4. Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management. Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring). Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks. Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  1. 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  2. Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  3. Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  4. Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  5. Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  6. Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  7. Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  8. Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  9. Experience with Secure Code Review.
  10. Understanding of software supply chain.
  11. Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  12. Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  13. Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  1. Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  2. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  3. Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  1. We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:
  2. Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  3. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  4. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  5. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  6. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  1. As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  2. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  3. We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  4. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  5. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  6. A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.
  7. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

description:
Details

  • Department: Ascension Data Science Institute
  • Schedule: Full-time, 8 hour day shift, Monday - Friday
  • Location: Remote
  • Salary: $82,825.00 - $115,453.00 per year

Benefits

  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Various health insurance options & wellness plan
  • Retirement benefits including employer match plan
  • Long-term & short-term disability
  • Employee assistance programs (EAP)
  • Parental leave & adoption assistance
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Ways to give back to your community
  • Benefit options and eligibility vary by position. Compensation varies based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, education, performance, location and salary range at the time of the offer.

Responsibilities

The Ascension Data Sciences Institute (ADSI) was created in July 2019 with the mission of supporting Ascension in achieving its Quadruple Aim with uniquely skilled, high-performing associates who develop analyses, models, and applications to enable Ascension in providing higher value healthcare and making strategic decisions. We recognize that the healthcare environment is a complex ecosystem of rapidly evolving clinical and economic practices that affect patient and provider experience and demands increasingly sophisticated and complex measurement. Our objective is for analytics and data science to play a critical and foundational role in the transformation of care delivery, quality and financial outcomes to enable our organization's competitive advantage.

We are hiring a Senior Analyst, Remote Patient Monitoring, within our Clinical Transformation team in ADSI, to support Ascension's goal to differentiate ourselves on patient quality and innovation. Clinical Transformation is a rapidly growing division of the company working to leverage health technologies that include AI, wearables, virtual care, personalized patient messaging, and remote patient monitoring - with our team leading analytic efforts around these programs. In this position, you will be responsible for supporting our growing space of remote patient monitoring programs, including new wearable device integrations and other device-based patient monitoring programs. You will be integrated within a multi-disciplinary group of analysts, data scientists, developers, engineers, and medical professionals, supporting the rapid development, monitoring, reporting, and scaling of these digital programs.

As an ideal candidate, you will bring strong technical expertise in data processing and reporting pipelines, as well as data exploration, visualization, and quality control. Experience in clinical settings and/or wearable or other technology integrations in healthcare are pluses. To be successful, you will need to have strong SQL skills, natural curiosity and eagerness to learn, and enjoy working in a high-performing team.

Core Responsibilities

  • Support remote patient monitoring program data requirements and quality assurance
  • Develop, build and maintain key performance indicators, in partnership with clinical leadership, including provider, patient, and business outcome metrics as well as implementation & expansion reporting
  • Support the evaluation of existing programs to ensure alignment with business and financial performance
  • Build and monitor data processing pipelines, working closely with data engineering and other technical teams to manage the data infrastructure needed to evaluate and scale programs
  • Build reporting dashboards that deliver on clinical and business stakeholder requirements, including documentation of data elements and metrics
  • Support ad hoc analytic requests and communicate findings to stakeholders to provide data-driven insights and guidance

Work Experience

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Strong SQL skills are required (Please note, the interview process will include a SQL assessment.)
  • Experience working with EHR, medical billing and coding, claims, and/or other healthcare data is preferred
  • Experience in clinical settings and/or wearable or other technology integrations in healthcare is desirable
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Tableau, Looker, and/or Salesforce is desirable

Opportunities

  • This role directly supports an innovative and research-focused team, there are opportunities to contribute to research design and scientific publication(s) on program effectiveness and patient outcomes

Qualifications

Education:

  • High school diploma/GED with 2 years of experience, or Associate's degree, or Bachelor's degree required.

Work Experience:

  • 3 years of experience preferred.

Additional Information

No additional preferences.

Ascension associates are key to our commitment of transforming healthcare and providing care to all, especially those most in need. Join us and help us drive impact through reimagining how we can deliver a people-centered healthcare experience and creating the solutions to do it. Ascension is a leading non-profit, faith-based national health system made up of over 134,000 associates and 2,600 sites of care, including more than 140 hospitals and 40 senior living communities in 19 states.
